name: lamin A/C

function.text: LMNA encodes prelamin-A/C [Cleaved into: Lamin-A/C]. Annotated molecular activities include structural molecule activity and structural constituent of cytoskeleton. It participates in regulation of telomere maintenance and cellular senescence.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to dilated cardiomyopathy 1A (autosomal dominant); lipodystrophy (semidominant). Additional curated associations are listed below.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include NTRK-rearranged spindle cell neoplasm, malignant. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
